description_sq:
Shitet Apartament 3+1+2 tualete + 2 ballkone tek ish Tregu Elektrik prane kompleksit Grand.
Apartamenti organizohet ne nje korridor , tre dhoma gjumi dy tualete si dhe 2 ballkone.
Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe prej rreth 131 m2 bruto dhe 109 m2 neto.
Apartamenti eshte kati i trete i nje ndertese tre kateshe pa ashensor.
Hyrjet jane me vete. Ka mundesine e nje posti parkimi me cmim ekstra simbolik.
Ballkonet kane pamje te lire.
Apartamenti shitet i mobiluar dhe me certifikate pronesie.
Eshte e mundur qe te shitet edhe me kredi
Per nje vizite ne prone me kontaktoni!

description_en: Apartment for sale 3+1+2 bathrooms + 2 balconies in the former Electric Market near the Grand complex. The apartment is organized in a corridor, three bedrooms, two bathrooms and 2 balconies. The apartment has an area of ​​about 131 m2 gross and 109 m2 net. The apartment is on the third floor of a three-story building without an elevator. Entrances are with you. There is the possibility of a parking post with an extra symbolic price. The balconies have a free view. The apartment is sold furnished and with ownership certificates. It is possible to sell with credit. For a visit to the property, contact me! ID: 530221066-172
